name: Mira

appearance.eyes: Amber-gold, narrow and sharp like a cat's — unsettling and striking in equal measure
appearance.hair: Golden, worn loose so a curtain of it falls across one eye
appearance.build: Lean and flexible — gymnast's frame, moves like water
appearance.armor: Brown leather jacket, worn close-fit, with a custom interior pocket for her rapier
appearance.overall: Exotic and immediately noticeable; carries herself with quiet authority

features.name: Fighting Style: Dueling
features.detail: +2 damage when wielding a melee weapon in one hand with no other weapon

traits: Stands between trouble and the people she's decided to protect.
Gymnast's body — fights with unusual flexibility and fluid movement.
Speaks in a calm, low voice even when the room is on fire.
Animals take to her immediately. She doesn't find it strange.
ideals: Injustice is an invitation. She doesn't walk past it.
Nature and people deserve the same protection. Neither is disposable.
bonds: Her parents bore the cost of a war they didn't start. She carries that debt into every fight.
Her companions have her full loyalty. A friend in need is a problem she will solve.
flaws: Doesn't know when to back down. Personal injury doesn't register until it's too late.

notes: Human Fighter. DEX-based, brown leather jacket (armor), rapier in interior pocket. Second Wind recharges on short rest. Subclass chosen at level 3. Acrobatics proficiency covers her gymnast flexibility mechanically.
